title: Immich ML Job Queue Depth
app: Kubernetes homelab clusters, Proxmox, Vaultwarden, Paperless-ngx, Immich, AdGuard Home, Docker, TrueNAS, and NUT metrics via APIs, logs, Telegraf, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=immich:job
| stats count(eval(status="queued")) as queued_jobs by job_type
| where queued_jobs>10
| sort - queued_jobs
description: Uses Immich job telemetry telemetry to monitor queued machine-learning jobs by job type in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for photo-processing backlogs that delay search and face grouping, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Immich job telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Job-type table of queued Immich work.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds queued machine-learning jobs by job type so you can spot photo-processing backlogs that delay search and face grouping before it becomes annoying.
